title: (RHBA-2016:1921) rhevm-image-uploader bug fix update for RHEV 3.6.9
portal_summary: Updated rhevm-image-uploader packages that fix one bug are now available.
portal_synopsis: rhevm-image-uploader bug fix update for RHEV 3.6.9
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The rhevm-image-uploader package provides a streamlined process for uploading a virtual appliance stored as an OVF archive to a Red Hat Enterprise Virtualization export storage domain.

Changes to the rhevm-image-uploader component:

* Authentication has now been fixed so that images can be uploaded to the Red Hat Enterprise Virtualization Manager with Kerberos SSO enabled. (BZ#1364471)
